Reconciles supplied declaration rows with pinned source hashes and exact literal headers, then emits manual textual observations. Required configuration is absent: source and entry-prefix role only, no passing, helper/input-data, generation-result, ownership, Lean parsing, semantic/dependency closure, runtime or proof credit.
